headline: Small and clean today, but the real swell is loading up for Mon-Tue.
today: Fun-size 1.4-1.8ft on a good SE angle with offshore wind at dawn and again in the evening — get the early glass before the NW cross builds. Log or fish the incoming tide toward the 1:51p high. Fine session, but the week here is all about what's coming.

daysToWatch.note: Swell fills in to 3ft+ on a prime E angle, but NE cross-on keeps it bumpy. Surfable, better days behind it.
3-3.3ft solid on a prime E angle with cross-off dawn wind. Shortboard day — the drive starts making sense.
The one to rearrange plans for: 2.2-2.9ft at 7s+ prime E angle with offshore-to-light wind all day. Cleanest, longest-period day of the week anywhere. Make the drive.
